lines.text: This is Overtime Calculator. It works out your pay the way your company does, and it all stays on your phone.
Start at the top. Enter your basic pay and food allowance once. The app carries them to every month.
Pick the month you worked. If you know your overtime, type it in, or tap plus and minus half an hour at a time.
Or count it day by day. Enter your time at work, lunch included. The app takes lunch off and counts everything past nine hours. Next moves you to the next day.
On a Friday or a holiday, everything after lunch is overtime. Absent is deducted. Medical leave is paid, with no overtime.
Faster still: screenshot your attendance report and import it. The app checks it against the report's totals. The Import video shows every step.
When every day of a month is filled in, it saves itself to History. Change a day later, and History follows.
When your payslip arrives, enter what you were paid. The app shows any difference, and reminds you that overtime comes with the next month's salary.
Each year adds up your overtime against the legal limit of 720 hours, and any month can be shared as a PDF.
End of Service shows what you'd get if you left. Use the date of your first contract. Resigning pays less in the first ten years; a contract that ends pays in full.
Add your leave and air ticket. Enter unpaid leave one stretch at a time. The first twenty days of each still count as service.
Settings holds your company's rules: an eight-hour day plus lunch, your shift for missed punches, and a day's pay as one thirtieth of the month.
Set when overtime is paid, get reminders before your iqama expires, switch to Arabic, and back everything up.
Your pay, checked. Everything stays on your phone.
